extraction_notes: Curve points are manual reads from the published typical-characteristics figures and are not interpolated between unrelated traces; plotted pF, nC, and mOhm values were converted to SI units.
The transfer figure publishes 25 degC and 150 degC curves at VDS = 5 V; both usable traces are included.
The capacitance figure has a logarithmic capacitance axis and does not state VGS or test frequency; these conditions are recorded as unspecified rather than inferred from the dynamic-parameter table.

The static table publishes RDS(on) maximum limits of 0.025 ohm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 4.5 A, 0.032 ohm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 3 A, and 0.046 ohm at VGS = 1.8 V and ID = 2.7 A; all corresponding typical and maximum values are represented in rdson_points.

The switching table publishes Qg = 6.06 nC, Qgs = 1.07 nC, Qgd = 1.95 nC, Qrr = 1.38 nC, and trr = 17.9 ns; the supplied schema has no dedicated fields for gate charge or reverse-recovery charge/time.

The static table publishes IDSS maximum 1.0 uA at VDS = 20 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS maximum +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-10 V and VDS = 0 V, and gate resistance typical 2.7 ohm at f = 1 MHz; the supplied schema has no dedicated leakage or gate-resistance fields.

The maximum-ratings table publishes RthetaJA = 125 K/W maximum; the supplied schema has no thermal-resistance fields. The safe-operating-area figure on p. 4 was examined but is not included as a model-fitting curve because the supplied schema has no dedicated SOA field.
